Joe McCoul had a serious accident
Tuesday at Yan Eeghan's Garner creek
ranch. He was haulinga load of posts
with a gentle horse and a broncho when
the latter started to run away, throwing
Joe off the load, breaking his leg and
spraining his ankle. -He was brought
to town and ia now at the Pyramid Park
hotel. Dr. Dnnean was called from
Glendive and states that the fracture is
not serious but the sprain is liable to
cause trouble.

Again we weep. Our proud position
as. fighting editor will be occupied by us
no more forever. Our heavy-weight
assistant who at train time makes the
air musical and the pilgrims'eyes bug
out by his blood-curdling' way of shout
ing: ."B-a-d L-a-n-d-s C-o-w B-o-y" has
usurped our prerogative, so to speak.
A callow news-boy who objected to the
aforesaid heavy-weight assistant's pres
ence on the train is now mourning his
rash objection. So, we might add, are
his eyes. The above should be a warn
ing both now and -forever1 to all news
boTB not to interfere with Our b-a-d man.

A little breeze of excitement was
created this morning by the barbershop
